topic: Web Development with Flask and REST APIs
learningObjectives: Explain the structure of a basic Flask web application.
Create routes that handle HTTP requests and return responses.
Design a simple REST API using Flask.

activities.title: Flask Architecture
activities.instruction: Explore how a Flask application handles a web request.

content.concept: A Flask application maps incoming HTTP requests to route functions, executes application logic, and returns an HTTP response.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: The Flask application object that receives incoming requests.
URL and HTTP method mapping that determines which function handles a request.
Python function executed for a matching route.
Code that processes the request and prepares the result.
HTTP response returned to the client.

activities.title: Route Anatomy
activities.instruction: Explore the parts of a Flask route.

content.concept: The @app.route decorator associates a URL path and optionally HTTP methods with a Python function.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Registers the /users URL and allows GET requests for this route.
Defines the Python function that handles the matching request.
Returns structured data that Flask can serialize as a response.

activities.title: REST Method Explorer
activities.instruction: Choose the HTTP method that best matches each REST operation.

content.concept: REST APIs commonly use GET to retrieve resources, POST to create resources, PUT or PATCH to update resources, and DELETE to remove resources.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Flask API Builder
activities.instruction: Build a simple Flask endpoint that returns JSON data.

content.concept: A Flask REST endpoint combines a route, an HTTP method, a view function, and a response containing structured data.
